meta.name: hyperframes-audio
meta.description: Use when audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition needs to be mixed: fade-in/fade-out, crossfade, track gain or volume, volume automation, ducking, a music bed that fights a voiceover (voiceover carve), effects on a track (EQ, compressor, limiter, gate, saturation, delay, reverb, chorus, phaser, bitcrush), automation envelopes drawn on a track's volume or any effect parameter, or one submix bus carrying a chain, a fader and an automation clock for several tracks at once (`<hf-audio-group>`). Don't use for sourcing or generating audio — finding BGM, SFX, or making a voiceover is `/media-use`. Don't use for clip timing or track layout, which is `/hyperframes-core`.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让配音和背景音乐不再互相盖住,把音量、淡化与效果调到刚好。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果视频旁白总被背景音乐压住,或需要给多条音轨统一调音。
copy.tagline_en: Balance voiceover against music and shape fades, ducking and effects per track.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your voiceover keeps getting buried by the music and you need it fixed.

howto.what: Claude 会给已经放进 HyperFrames 合成里的音频做混音:淡入淡出、轨道增益与音量自动化、人声闪避(让音乐床给配音让位)、EQ/压缩/限制器等效果链,以及画在音量或效果参数上的自动化包络,写成可渲染的属性。
howto.when: 当你提到给已放置的音频做淡入淡出、交叉淡化、人声闪避等混音处理时触发。找 BGM、做配音请用 /media-use,片段时长与轨道布局归 /hyperframes-core。

say.text: 把这段音乐床压在人声下面,别让配音被盖住
say.note: 在音乐床元素上生成 carve 设置

say.text: 给这条人声加 80Hz 高通和 3kHz 清晰度提升
给这条轨道的音量画一条淡入淡出自动化

howto.what_en: Claude mixes audio already placed in a HyperFrames composition: fades, crossfades, track gain, volume automation, voiceover carve, effect chains (EQ, compressor, limiter) and automation envelopes on volume or effect parameters.
howto.when_en: Use when placed audio in a HyperFrames composition needs mixing — fades, crossfades, a voiceover carve. Sourcing or generating audio is /media-use; clip timing and track layout are /hyperframes-core.

say_en.text: Duck this music bed under the voiceover so the speech stays clear
say_en.note: writes carve settings on the bed element

say_en.text: Add an 80 Hz highpass and a 3 kHz clarity boost to this voice track
Draw a fade-in/fade-out automation lane on this track's volume
